What Codex is doing

Observe: read the controls and current state.

Your criteria define what the agent should verify.

Act: click, type, then inspect the change.

Ask to “use the built-in browser” or mention @Browser.

Review: compare evidence with the criteria.

Screenshots show states; people review the conclusion.

Codex UI testing lab

A UI change needs evidence

The recurring task: test a UI journey against acceptance criteria, whatever the app’s language.

Codex performs the browser interactions: you provide the criteria, inputs and boundaries.

You review the result: compare the observed values and screenshots before relying on the check.

OpenAI

Codex UI testing lab

One journey, three criteria

ATL → JFK January 22–25, 2030 2 passengers

AC-01: A valid search opens results.

Submit the round-trip search and inspect the results page.

AC-02: The summary matches all five inputs.

Compare both airports, both dates and the passenger count.

AC-08: Edit search retains those values.

Return to the form and inspect every control.

Your turn: ask Codex to verify

Use the built-in browser at https://flight-lab-ui-workshop.vivianamarquez.chatgpt.site.

Set ATL → JFK, departure January 22, 2030, return January 25, 2030, and 2 passengers.


AC-01: Submit and confirm that results open.

AC-02: Compare all five values in the summary.

AC-08: Click Edit search and check all five form values.


Report passed, failed or blocked for each criterion, with observed values and screenshots. Keep app code unchanged. Do not create a test yet.

Instructor demo: create a test

Create: ask Codex for a Python Playwright test of the verified hosted journey.

Review: match each assertion to a criterion. Check exact values and accessible labels.

Run: watch the saved test and inspect its result.

python -m pytest test_flight_search.py --headed

A proposed two-week pilot

Engineer: try one journey on your next UI change.

Record the criteria, observed values and evidence.

Reviewer: check the evidence before relying on it.

Compare screenshots and assertions with the requirement.

Team champion: collect friction and useful examples.

Hold office hours, then review progress after two weeks.

OpenAI

Codex UI testing lab

Measure useful adoption

Proposed measures — no pilot results yet.

Adoption: do engineers use it again?

Track the share completing a second reviewer-accepted workflow.

Outcome: does it reduce validation effort?

Measure time to an accepted check, including review and rework.

Compare with a manual baseline.

Review quality before expanding to more teams.
